page: Microsoft Azure D48ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dadv6 server family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The instance features 48 dedicated vCPUs derived from 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. For local storage, the server includes a bundled 2835 GB local disk and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. The virtualization layer is managed by Microsoft Hyper-V.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong overall performance, with multi-core processing capabilities ranking in the top 25% for stress-ng and top 10% for Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory performance is robust, showing top 25% results in cached small-block read bandwidth, though large-block uncached read and write operations fall into the middle 50% average tier. Cryptographic and database operations, such as Redis SET operations executing at 63.99 million operations per second, consistently score in the top 25%. For specialized workloads, the server demonstrates strong performance in software compilation, ray tracing, and text processing. Large-scale LLM inference, however, shows a notable performance drop, with text generation for 70B models falling into the bottom 10%.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the D48ads_v6 offers a balanced resource density, combining high-capacity local storage with a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. This configuration avoids the premium costs associated with memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated instances while delivering high-throughput compute. The server is well-suited for relational databases, multi-threaded software compilation, web serving, and medium-scale data processing. It is also appropriate for small-to-medium language model inference tasks, though it is not recommended for large-scale deep learning or heavy LLM text generation due to the absence of hardware accelerators.
description: The Microsoft Azure D48ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs, 192.0 GB of RAM, and a bundled 2835 GB local disk. Operating under Microsoft Hyper-V, this instance delivers strong multi-core performance, ranking in the top 10% on Geekbench multi-core benchmarks. It excels in database operations, software compilation, and multi-threaded decompression, while maintaining average performance in large-block memory bandwidth and static web serving. Lacking a GPU, it is less suited for large-scale LLM inference but offers a cost-efficient, balanced profile for database hosting, general-purpose enterprise applications, and development pipelines.
